inspiration: Each monster is one row of fields: spawn state, see state, pain chance, death state, sound slots, speed, size in fixed point, mass, damage, and a flags word for enemy, special and shootable (src/info.c 4206-4232). This is a clean catalogue-as-data shape for row 21: one row per creature, the engine reads it at runtime.

Animation is a state chain: each state is a frame number, a tick count, an action, and the next state (src/info.c 848-854). An idle loop holds for five ticks and the chase loop steps every three ticks across six frames. Gives a plain vocabulary for idle and walk timing.

Death is a short chain of flicker frames that repeats a fixed number of times, then hands over to one shared explosion state (src/info.c 1077 and the same pattern at 1106 and 3885). A loss reads clearly in a crowd because every enemy ends the same way.
A one-hit enemy is flagged as an enemy, special and shootable, with the speed kept low (src/info.c 4209, 4222, 4229). The crowd feel comes from many one-hit bodies, not from tough ones.

The sound table has a caption column. An empty caption shows the sound id instead, and a closed-caption cvar switches the captions on (src/sounds.c 36 and 41; src/s_sound.c 88). This is the accessibility rule to copy: every combat cue has a readable caption that can be turned on.
The engine tables are in one file per family (monsters, states, sounds), with an enum for each kind (src/info.h 1196 and 4429). This matches the catalogue-as-runtime-source rule.

briefs.label: One-hit walker with a look-and-chase loop
briefs.why: A low-risk ground enemy that reads at a glance and comes in groups. The walk loop is short, so a crowd feels busy without many frames.
briefs.keep: one hit point; a six-frame chase loop stepping every three ticks; a shared death puff at the end
briefs.change: give it a low, wide crawling silhouette with a glowing seam along the back, not a human-like figure; add a short ember trail on death; use our own palette and tick timing
briefs.ref: src/info.c 4206-4232 (crawla row), src/info.c 848-854 (look and chase states). Recreate as an original crawler; do not copy the figure or the names.

briefs.label: Flicker-then-puff death
briefs.why: A short repeat flicker followed by one shared explosion makes every kill read the same way, even in a crowd.
briefs.keep: a fixed small repeat count before the shared end state; one explosion state reused by many enemies
briefs.change: our puff uses our own VFX palette and ends with a hold for hit-stop; the repeat count is zone data, not a constant in code
briefs.ref: src/info.c 1077 (flicker chain), 1106 and 3885 (same end state reused). Recreate as an original death effect.

briefs.label: Every combat cue has a caption
briefs.why: Players with sound off or hearing needs can still read the fight. Captions also teach the cues.
briefs.keep: a caption column next to each sound; an empty caption falls back to the cue id; a single on/off setting
briefs.change: captions name the cue in plain action words (parry, heavy hit, guard break) and show on the HUD bottom edge, not as subtitles; list them in the catalogue
briefs.ref: src/sounds.c 36, 41 and 182; src/s_sound.c 88. Recreate as an original caption set.

briefs.label: Many one-hit bodies flagged shootable
briefs.why: A crowd of fragile enemies gives pressure without making each fight long, which suits a many-vs-one duel.
briefs.keep: one hit point; enemy, special and shootable flags together; low speed
briefs.change: give each a one or two hit body with a different guard rule; add a short wind-up tell before the hit
briefs.ref: src/info.c 4209 and 4229 (crawla row). Recreate as original fodder enemies.

briefs.label: Fixed-tick state chain for idle and walk
briefs.why: Animation timing lives in one table of frame, ticks, action and next state. Easy to tune without touching code.
briefs.keep: frame, tick count, action, next state in one row; a null state at the end
briefs.change: drive the chain from our 60 Hz fight tick; add a flagged guard-window frame the engine reads; keep the table as zone data
briefs.ref: src/info.c 848-854 (state rows), src/info.h 1196 (S_NULL). Recreate as an original state table.
